texto: ## Editing — двухколоночная логика

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Editing — двухколоночная логика
texto: Endpoint: `openai/gpt-image-2/edit` (на fal.ai) или соответствующий через OpenAI API.

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Editing — двухколоночная логика
texto:
```
Change: [single concrete change]
Preserve: face, identity, pose, lighting, framing, background, geometry, text, layout
Constraints: no extra objects, no redesign, no drift
```

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Editing — двухколоночная логика
texto: **Правила edit:**

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Editing — двухколоночная логика
texto: - **Один edit за итерацию.** Не пытайся менять всё разом.

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Editing — двухколоночная логика
texto: - **Preserve list повторять каждую итерацию.** Иначе дрейф.

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Editing — двухколоночная логика
texto: - **Surgical edits:** явно перечисли что НЕ трогать (saturation, contrast, layout, arrows, labels, camera angle).

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Editing — двухколоночная логика
texto: - Опционально: `mask_image_url` для точечных edits.

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Editing — двухколоночная логика › Edit-паттерны
texto: ### Edit-паттерны

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Editing — двухколоночная логика › Edit-паттерны
texto: **Virtual try-on:** «Change garments only. Preserve exact face, body shape, pose, hair, expression, background, camera angle. Match lighting/shadows so outfit looks naturally worn.»

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Editing — двухколоночная логика › Edit-паттерны
texto: **Object removal:** «Remove [X]. Do not change anything else. Use `input_fidelity: high` to maintain surrounding context» (только gpt-image-1.5/1, в gpt-image-2 high-fidelity по умолчанию).

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Editing — двухколоночная логика › Edit-паттерны
texto: **Lighting/weather swap:** «Change ONLY environmental conditions: lighting direction/quality, shadows, atmosphere, precipitation. Preserve identity, geometry, camera angle, object placement.»

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Editing — двухколоночная логика › Edit-паттерны
texto: **Interior swap:** «Swap [furniture]. Preserve camera angle, lighting, shadows, surrounding context. Photorealistic contact shadows.»

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Multi-Image — до 16 рефов
texto: ## Multi-Image — до 16 рефов

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Multi-Image — до 16 рефов
texto: Индексируй с **ролью**, не только номером:

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Multi-Image — до 16 рефов
texto:
```
Image 1: base scene
Image 2: jacket reference (apply only the jacket fabric/cut to subject in Image 1)
Image 3: lighting reference (apply golden-hour quality from Image 3)
```

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Style Transfer
texto: ## Style Transfer

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Style Transfer
texto: Не пиши абстрактно («minimalist», «editorial»). Назови конкретные визуальные свойства референса: палитра, edge treatment, силуэт, обработка теней, plane логика.

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › World Knowledge
texto: ## World Knowledge

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › World Knowledge
texto: GPT Image 2 умеет домысливать контекст: «Bethel, NY, August 1969» → выведет Woodstock-эстетику. Используй: дай исторический/культурный анкер, не расписывай каждую деталь.

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Iteration Strategy
texto: ## Iteration Strategy

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Iteration Strategy
texto: - Стартуй с **чистого** базового промпта.

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Iteration Strategy
texto: - Один change за раунд. «Make lighting warmer», «remove extra tree», «restore original background».

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Iteration Strategy
texto: - При drift — перечисли invariants заново.

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Iteration Strategy
texto: - Для длинных промптов — labeled sections, не одна простыня.

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Use-Case Templates
texto: ## Use-Case Templates

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Use-Case Templates › Photoreal Editorial
texto: ### Photoreal Editorial

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Use-Case Templates › Photoreal Editorial
texto:
```
Scene: [location, time, weather]
Subject: [who, action, framing]
Important Details: [lens feel, light source, surface wear, imperfections, real texture]
Use Case: editorial photograph, looks like a real photo
Constraints: no glamorization, no heavy retouching, no studio gloss
```

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Use-Case Templates › Product Mockup (Clean Background)
texto: ### Product Mockup (Clean Background)

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Use-Case Templates › Product Mockup (Clean Background)
texto:
```
Scene: plain white opaque background
Subject: [product] centered
Important Details: crisp silhouette, no halos/fringing, light contact shadow,
  preserve label legibility exactly, preserve geometry
Use Case: product mockup
Constraints: no restyling, only background removal + light polish
```

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Use-Case Templates › UI Mockup
texto: ### UI Mockup

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Use-Case Templates › UI Mockup
texto:
```
Scene: [device frame, e.g. iPhone 15 Pro]
Subject: [screen/app name] — describe AS IF IT EXISTS, not concept art
Important Details: layout, hierarchy, real interface elements, exact copy in quotes,
  typography behavior, spacing, state
Use Case: shipped product screenshot
Constraints: no sketch language, no placeholder text, no Lorem Ipsum
Quality: high (for small UI text)
```

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Use-Case Templates › Marketing Creative with Text
texto: ### Marketing Creative with Text

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Use-Case Templates › Marketing Creative with Text
texto:
```
Scene: [environment]
Subject: [hero element]
Important Details: [composition, palette, mood]
Use Case: ad creative for [audience]
Text: "EXACT HEADLINE" in [font style], [color], [position]
      "exact subhead" in [font style], [color], [position]
Constraints: no extra text, no duplicate text, no watermarks, no unrelated logos
Quality: high
```

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Use-Case Templates › Infographic / Diagram
texto: ### Infographic / Diagram

encabezado: GPT Image 2 — Specific Rules › Use-Case Templates › Infographic / Diagram
texto:
```
Title: "[TITLE]"
Content flow: [step 1] → [step 2] → [step 3]
Visual format: [layout type — flowchart, pyramid, isometric, etc.]
Use Case: educational infographic for [audience]
Constraints: readable labels at all sizes, clear hierarchy, no clutter,
  no decorative noise, ample whitespace
Quality: high
Size: 1536×1024
```
